<StructureMap xmlns="http://hl7.org/fhir">
  <id value="CdaFrToBundle"/>
  <language value="fr"/>
  <text>
    <status value="generated"/>
    <div xml:lang="fr" lang="fr"><hr/><p><b>French</b></p><hr/><p class="res-header-id"><b>Narratif généré : StructureMap CdaFrToBundle</b></p><a name="CdaFrToBundle"> </a><a name="hcCdaFrToBundle"> </a><pre class="fml">
<b>map</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span>https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaFrToBundle<span style="color: navy">&quot; = &quot;</span>CdaFrToBundle<span style="color: navy">&quot;

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Mapping CDA-FR vers FHIR - Socle enrichi français</span>

<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">TYPES CDA UTILISÉS COMME SOURCES</span>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-ClinicalDocument.html" title="ClinicalDocument (CDA Class)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/ClinicalDocument|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>ClinicalDocument <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-PatientRole.html" title="PatientRole (CDA Class)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/PatientRole|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>PatientRole <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-PN.html" title="PN: PersonName (V3 Data Type)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/PN|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>PN <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-II.html" title="II: InstanceIdentifier (V3 Data Type)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/II|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>II <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-RelatedEntity.html" title="RelatedEntity (CDA Class)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/RelatedEntity|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>RelatedEntity <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-EncompassingEncounter.html" title="EncompassingEncounter (CDA Class)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/EncompassingEncounter|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>EncompassingEncounter <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/2.0.0-sd/StructureDefinition-HealthCareFacility.html" title="HealthCareFacility (CDA Class)">http://hl7.org/cda/stds/core/StructureDefinition/HealthCareFacility|2.0.0-sd</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>HealthCareFacility <b>as </b><b>source</b>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">TYPES FHIR UTILISÉS COMME CIBLES</span>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/bundle.html" title="Bundle">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Bundle <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/composition.html" title="Composition">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Composition|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Composition <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/patient.html" title="Patient">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Patient <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#HumanName" title="HumanName">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/HumanName|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>HumanName <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/extensibility.html#Extension" title="Extension">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Extension|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Extension <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Address" title="Address">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Address|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Address <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Coding" title="Coding">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Coding|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Coding <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Identifier" title="Identifier">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Identifier|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Identifier <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#CodeableConcept" title="CodeableConcept">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/CodeableConcept|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>CodeableConcept <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/organization.html" title="Organization">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Organization|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Organization <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/practitioner.html" title="Practitioner">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Practitioner|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Practitioner <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/practitionerrole.html" title="PractitionerRole">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/PractitionerRole|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>PractitionerRole <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/relatedperson.html" title="RelatedPerson">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/RelatedPerson|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>RelatedPerson <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/encounter.html" title="Encounter">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Encounter|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Encounter <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/location.html" title="Location">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Location|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Location <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#Meta" title="Meta">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Meta|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>Meta <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#code" title="code">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/code|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>code <b>as </b><b>target</b>
<b>uses</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="http://hl7.org/fhir/R4/datatypes.html#string" title="string">http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/string|4.0.1</a><span style="color: navy">&quot; </span><b>alias </b>string <b>as </b><b>target</b>

<b>imports</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="StructureMap-CdaToFHIRTypes.html" title="Mapping de CDA vers les FHIR Types (A partir des sources de Oliver Egger)">https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToFHIRTypes</a><span style="color: navy">&quot;
</span><b>imports</b><span style="color: navy"> &quot;</span><a href="StructureMap-CdaToBundle.html" title="Mapping CDA vers FHIR - Étape 2 socle générique orienté CDA">https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToBundle</a><span style="color: navy">&quot;
</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">GROUPE D’ENTRÉE — CRÉATION DU SOCLE FRANÇAIS</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Ce groupe crée le Bundle final de l’étape 3 avec Composition et Patient.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Les autres ressources administratives sont créées dans les groupes CDA qui</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   les justifient, afin d’éviter les ressources optionnelles vides</span>
<b>group </b>TransformClinicalDocumentToFrenchFHIRDocument<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>ClinicalDocument, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy"> : </span>Bundle<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  cda<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">compositionEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> compositionEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Composition'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> composition.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> compositionEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %composition.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patientEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Patient'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patient.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> patientEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFrenchTransformation<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;main&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">GROUPE D’ORCHESTRATION — SOCLE GÉNÉRIQUE + ENRICHISSEMENT FRANÇAIS</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Ce groupe suit la structure du ClinicalDocument CDA.</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Il appelle d’abord le traitement français de l’en-tête, où chaque ressource</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   optionnelle est créée dans le groupe correspondant au bloc CDA. Il appelle</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   ensuite le corps générique de l’étape 2 pour créer les sections narratives</span>
<b>group </b>OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFrenchTransformation<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">cda</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">composition</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA ClinicalDocument.header -&gt; socle générique + enrichissement français</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;headerFrenchBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA ClinicalDocument.structuredBody -&gt; FHIR Composition.section title/code/text</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapClinicalDocumentBody<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;body&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">GROUPE — EN-TÊTE CDA AVEC RÈGLES FRANÇAISES</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   Ce groupe reprend l’organisation de l’en-tête CDA. Les ressources optionnelles</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   sont créées dans les sous-groupes correspondant aux blocs CDA, puis remplies</span>
<span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">   avec les groupes génériques de l’étape 2 et enrichies avec les groupes français</span>
<b>group </b>MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">cda</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">composition</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA ClinicalDocument -&gt; profils généraux Bundle / Composition</span>
  <span style="color: #b36b00" title="Cet élément n'était pas défini avant R5">// cda -&gt; bundle.meta as bundleMeta then { cda -&gt; bundleMeta.profile = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle' &quot;bundleGenericProfile&quot;; } &quot;bundleMetaProfile&quot;;</span>
  <span style="color: #b36b00" title="Cet élément n'était pas défini avant R5">// cda -&gt; composition.meta as compositionMeta then { cda -&gt; compositionMeta.profile = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Composition' &quot;compositionGenericProfile&quot;; } &quot;compositionMetaProfile&quot;;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA ClinicalDocument -&gt; FHIR Bundle.meta.profile EU EPS</span>
  cda<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundle.meta<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">bundleMeta</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    cda<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>bundleMeta.profile = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/bundle-eu-eps'</span> <i>&quot;bundleEUEPSProfile&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;bundleMetaProfile&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA ClinicalDocument -&gt; FHIR Composition.meta.profile EU EPS</span>
  cda<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>composition.meta<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">compositionMeta</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    cda<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>compositionMeta.profile = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/composition-eu-eps'</span> <i>&quot;compositionEUEPSProfile&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;compositionMetaProfile&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA id/setId/versionNumber/effectiveTime -&gt; FHIR métadonnées Bundle + Composition</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderDocumentIdentity<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;documentIdentity&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA languageCode/code/title/effectiveTime/confidentialityCode -&gt; FHIR description de la Composition</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderDocumentDescription<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;documentDescription&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA recordTarget.patientRole -&gt; Patient générique + enrichissement français</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderRecordTarget<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;recordTargetBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  cda.recordTarget<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">recordTarget</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    recordTarget.patientRole<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">patientRole</span><b> then </b>MapCDARecordTargetToFrenchPatient<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">patientRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;patientFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;recordTargetFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA custodian -&gt; Organization custodian générique + française</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderCustodianWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;custodian&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA author -&gt; Practitioner / Organization / PractitionerRole génériques + français</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderAuthorWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;author&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA legalAuthenticator -&gt; signataire légal générique + français</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderLegalAuthenticatorWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;legalAuthenticator&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA documentationOf.serviceEvent -&gt; FHIR Composition.event</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderDocumentationOf<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;documentationOf&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA componentOf.encompassingEncounter -&gt; Encounter / Location / Organization génériques + français</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderEncounterContextWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">composition</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;encounterContext&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA informant ECON/NOK -&gt; RelatedPerson génériques + françaises</span>
  cda<b> then </b>MapHeaderEmergencyContactWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">cda</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">bundle</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;emergencyContact&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

          assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">legalRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">legalPractitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">legalOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;legalRoleBase&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          assignedEntity<b> then </b>MapCDAAssignedEntityToFrenchPractitionerRole<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">assignedEntity</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">legalRole</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">legalPractitioner</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">legalOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;legalRoleFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
          assignedEntity<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> attester.party = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">partyRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> partyRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %legalRole.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;partyRole&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA componentOf.encompassingEncounter -&gt; création Encounter / Location / Organization + enrichissement français</span>
<b>group </b>MapHeaderEncounterContextWithFrenchRules<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">composition</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">bundle</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>  src.componentOf<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">componentOf</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    componentOf.encompassingEncounter<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">encompassingEncounter</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">encounterEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> encounterEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Encounter'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">encounter</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> encounter.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> encounterEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %encounter.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA encompassingEncounter -&gt; FHIR Composition.encounter</span>
      encompassingEncounter<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> composition.encounter = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Reference'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">encRef</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> encRef.reference = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %encounter.id<span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;compositionEncounterRef&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Cas 1 : healthCareFacility présent -&gt; Encounter + Location + Organization</span>
      encompassingEncounter.location<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">srcLocation</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>        srcLocation.healthCareFacility<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">facility</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">locationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> locationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Location'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">location</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> location.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> locationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %location.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> bundle.entry<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">facilityOrganizationEntry</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> facilityOrganizationEntry.resource = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Organization'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">facilityOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> facilityOrganization.id = <b>uuid</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">, </span> facilityOrganizationEntry.fullUrl = <span style="color: navy">(</span>'urn:uuid:' + %facilityOrganization.id<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>          <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Groupe français d’orchestration :</span>
          <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">appelle le générique de l’étape 2 puis les enrichissements français de l’étape 3.</span>
          encompassingEncounter<b> then </b>MapCDAEncounterContextToFrenchResources<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">encompassingEncounter</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">facility</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">encounter</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">location</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">facilityOrganization</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;encounterContextFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
        <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;facilityResources&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">}</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Cas 2 : encompassingEncounter présent mais sans location</span>
      encompassingEncounter<b> where </b><span style="color: navy">(</span>encompassingEncounter.location.empty()<span style="color: navy">)</span><b> then </b>MapCDAEncounterOnlyToFrenchResources<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">encompassingEncounter</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">encounter</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;encounterOnlyFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">Cas 3 : location présente mais sans healthCareFacility</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;encounterResource&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

          guardian.telecom<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">telecom</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>guardianRelatedPerson.telecom = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'ContactPoint'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">contactPoint</span><b> then </b>TELContactPoint<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">telecom</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">contactPoint</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy">;</span>

          guardian<b> then </b>MapCDAGuardianToFrenchRelatedPerson<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">guardian</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">guardianRelatedPerson</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">patient</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;guardianFR&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><b>group </b>MapCDARecordTargetToFrenchPatient<span style="color: navy">(</span><b>source</b> <span style="color: maroon">src</span>, <b>target</b> <span style="color: maroon">tgt</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"> {

  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA patientRole.id INS-NIA -&gt; FHIR Patient.extension identity reliability VALI</span>
  src.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><b> where </b><span style="color: navy">(</span>id.root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.4.9'<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identityReliability</span><b> then </b>MapCDAIIToIdentityReliabilityVALI<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identityReliability</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identityReliabilityNIA&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA patientRole.id INS-NIR-TEST -&gt; FHIR Patient.extension identity reliability VALI</span>
  src.id<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">id</span><b> where </b><span style="color: navy">(</span>id.root = '1.2.250.1.213.1.4.10'<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">identityReliability</span><b> then </b>MapCDAIIToIdentityReliabilityVALI<span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">id</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: maroon">identityReliability</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;identityReliabilityNIRTest&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA PN patient.name -&gt; FHIR HumanName officiel</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA patient.birthplace -&gt; FHIR Patient.extension birthPlace</span>

</span><span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA healthCareFacility -&gt; FHIR Organization facility française</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA serviceProviderOrganization sans nom ni id -&gt; FHIR Organization.name data-absent-reason</span>
  src.serviceProviderOrganization<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">serviceProviderOrganization</span><b> where </b><span style="color: navy">(</span>serviceProviderOrganization.name.empty() and serviceProviderOrganization.id.empty()<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>tgt.name = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">nameString</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {

</span>      serviceProviderOrganization<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>

</span>      code<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.system = <span style="color: blue">'https://mos.esante.gouv.fr/NOS/TRE_R216-HL7RoleCode/FHIR/TRE-R216-HL7RoleCode'</span> <i>&quot;system&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      code<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.code = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">code</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;code&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      relationCode.displayName<b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>coding.display = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: maroon">display</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'string'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;display&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;coding&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;relationshipRole&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">// </span><span style="color: green">CDA guardian.code absent -&gt; FHIR RelatedPerson.relationship data-absent-reason</span>
  guardian<b> where </b><span style="color: navy">(</span>guardian.code.empty()<span style="color: navy">)</span><span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>relatedPerson.relationship = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'CodeableConcept'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">cc</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>    guardian<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>cc.extension = <b>create</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'Extension'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span><b> as </b><span style="color: maroon">absentReason</span><b> then</b><span style="color: navy"> {
</span>      guardian<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.url = <span style="color: blue">'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/data-absent-reason'</span> <i>&quot;url&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
      guardian<span style="color: navy"><b> -&gt; </b></span>absentReason.value = <b>cast</b><span style="color: navy">(</span><span style="color: blue">'unknown'</span><span style="color: navy">, </span><span style="color: blue">'code'</span><span style="color: navy">)</span> <i>&quot;valueCode&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
    <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;dataAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
  <span style="color: navy">}</span> <i>&quot;relationshipAbsentReason&quot;</i><span style="color: navy">;</span>
<span style="color: navy">}

</span></pre></div>
  </text>
  <url

  <publisher
             value="Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) - 2-10 Rue d'Oradour-sur-Glane, 75015 Paris"/>

    <alias value="Composition"/>

  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient|4.0.1"/>

  </structure>
  <structure>
    <url
         value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/PractitionerRole|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="PractitionerRole"/>

  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/RelatedPerson|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="RelatedPerson"/>
  </structure>
  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Encounter|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="Encounter"/>
  </structure>
  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Location|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="Location"/>

  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Meta|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="Meta"/>
  </structure>
  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/code|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="code"/>
  </structure>
  <structure>
    <url value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/string|4.0.1"/>
    <mode value="target"/>
    <alias value="string"/>
  </structure>
  <import
          value="https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToFHIRTypes"/>
  <import
          value="https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/mappingcdafhir/StructureMap/CdaToBundle"/>
  <group>
    <name value="TransformClinicalDocumentToFrenchFHIRDocument"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="GROUPE D’ENTRÉE — CRÉATION DU SOCLE FRANÇAIS
   Ce groupe crée le Bundle final de l’étape 3 avec Composition et Patient.
   Les autres ressources administratives sont créées dans les groupes CDA qui
   les justifient, afin d’éviter les ressources optionnelles vides"/>
    <input>
      <name value="cda"/>
      <type value="ClinicalDocument"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <type value="Bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="main"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <target>
        <context value="bundle"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="entry"/>
        <variable value="compositionEntry"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="compositionEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="resource"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <transform value="create"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="Composition"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="composition"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="id"/>
        <transform value="uuid"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="compositionEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="fullUrl"/>
        <transform value="evaluate"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="'urn:uuid:' + %composition.id"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="bundle"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="entry"/>
        <variable value="patientEntry"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="patientEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="resource"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
        <transform value="create"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="Patient"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="patient"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="id"/>
        <transform value="uuid"/>
      </target>
      <target>
        <context value="patientEntry"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="fullUrl"/>
        <transform value="evaluate"/>
        <parameter>
          <valueString value="'urn:uuid:' + %patient.id"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>
      <dependent>
        <name value="OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFrenchTransformation"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
  </group>
  <group>
    <name value="OrchestrateClinicalDocumentFrenchTransformation"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="GROUPE D’ORCHESTRATION — SOCLE GÉNÉRIQUE + ENRICHISSEMENT FRANÇAIS
   Ce groupe suit la structure du ClinicalDocument CDA.
   Il appelle d’abord le traitement français de l’en-tête, où chaque ressource
   optionnelle est créée dans le groupe correspondant au bloc CDA. Il appelle
   ensuite le corps générique de l’étape 2 pour créer les sections narratives"/>
    <input>
      <name value="cda"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="patient"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="composition"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="headerFrenchBase"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA ClinicalDocument.header -&gt; socle générique + enrichissement français"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="body"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapClinicalDocumentBody"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA ClinicalDocument.structuredBody -&gt; FHIR Composition.section title/code/text"/>
    </rule>
  </group>
  <group>
    <name value="MapClinicalDocumentHeaderWithFrenchRules"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="GROUPE — EN-TÊTE CDA AVEC RÈGLES FRANÇAISES
   Ce groupe reprend l’organisation de l’en-tête CDA. Les ressources optionnelles
   sont créées dans les sous-groupes correspondant aux blocs CDA, puis remplies
   avec les groupes génériques de l’étape 2 et enrichies avec les groupes français"/>
    <input>
      <name value="cda"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="composition"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="patient"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="bundleMetaProfile"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <target>
        <context value="bundle"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="meta"/>
        <variable value="bundleMeta"/>
      </target>
      <rule>
        <name value="bundleEUEPSProfile"/>
        <source>
          <context value="cda"/>
        </source>
        <target>
          <context value="bundleMeta"/>
          <contextType value="variable"/>
          <element value="profile"/>
          <transform value="copy"/>
          <parameter>
            <valueString
                         value="http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/bundle-eu-eps"/>
          </parameter>
        </target>
      </rule>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA ClinicalDocument -&gt; profils généraux Bundle / Composition
cda -&gt; bundle.meta as bundleMeta then { cda -&gt; bundleMeta.profile = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Bundle' &quot;bundleGenericProfile&quot;; } &quot;bundleMetaProfile&quot;;
cda -&gt; composition.meta as compositionMeta then { cda -&gt; compositionMeta.profile = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Composition' &quot;compositionGenericProfile&quot;; } &quot;compositionMetaProfile&quot;;
CDA ClinicalDocument -&gt; FHIR Bundle.meta.profile EU EPS"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="compositionMetaProfile"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <target>
        <context value="composition"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>
        <element value="meta"/>
        <variable value="compositionMeta"/>
      </target>
      <rule>
        <name value="compositionEUEPSProfile"/>
        <source>
          <context value="cda"/>
        </source>
        <target>
          <context value="compositionMeta"/>
          <contextType value="variable"/>
          <element value="profile"/>
          <transform value="copy"/>
          <parameter>
            <valueString
                         value="http://hl7.eu/fhir/eps/StructureDefinition/composition-eu-eps"/>
          </parameter>
        </target>
      </rule>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA ClinicalDocument -&gt; FHIR Composition.meta.profile EU EPS"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="documentIdentity"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderDocumentIdentity"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA id/setId/versionNumber/effectiveTime -&gt; FHIR métadonnées Bundle + Composition"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="documentDescription"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderDocumentDescription"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA languageCode/code/title/effectiveTime/confidentialityCode -&gt; FHIR description de la Composition"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="recordTargetBase"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderRecordTarget"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA recordTarget.patientRole -&gt; Patient générique + enrichissement français"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="recordTargetFR"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
        <element value="recordTarget"/>
        <variable value="recordTarget"/>
      </source>
      <rule>
        <name value="patientFR"/>
        <source>
          <context value="recordTarget"/>
          <element value="patientRole"/>
          <variable value="patientRole"/>
        </source>
        <dependent>
          <name value="MapCDARecordTargetToFrenchPatient"/>
          <variable value="patientRole"/>
          <variable value="patient"/>
        </dependent>
      </rule>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="custodian"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderCustodianWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA custodian -&gt; Organization custodian générique + française"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="author"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderAuthorWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA author -&gt; Practitioner / Organization / PractitionerRole génériques + français"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="legalAuthenticator"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderLegalAuthenticatorWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA legalAuthenticator -&gt; signataire légal générique + français"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="documentationOf"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderDocumentationOf"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA documentationOf.serviceEvent -&gt; FHIR Composition.event"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="encounterContext"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderEncounterContextWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA componentOf.encompassingEncounter -&gt; Encounter / Location / Organization génériques + français"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="emergencyContact"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderEmergencyContactWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA informant ECON/NOK -&gt; RelatedPerson génériques + françaises"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="trustedPerson"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderTrustedPersonWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="guardian"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderGuardianWithFrenchRules"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="bundle"/>
        <variable value="patient"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA guardian -&gt; RelatedPerson générique + française"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="relatedDocument"/>
      <source>
        <context value="cda"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapHeaderRelatedDocument"/>
        <variable value="cda"/>
        <variable value="composition"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA relatedDocument -&gt; FHIR Composition.relatesTo"/>
    </rule>
  </group>
  <group>
    <name value="MapHeaderCustodianWithFrenchRules"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="CDA custodian -&gt; création Organization + socle générique + enrichissement français"/>
    <input>
      <name value="src"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="composition"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="bundle"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="custodian"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <element value="custodian"/>
        <variable value="custodian"/>
      </source>
      <rule>
        <name value="assignedCustodian"/>
        <source>
          <context value="custodian"/>
          <element value="assignedCustodian"/>
          <variable value="assignedCustodian"/>
        </source>
        <rule>
          <name value="custodianOrganizationResource"/>
          <source>
            <context value="assignedCustodian"/>
            <element value="representedCustodianOrganization"/>
            <variable value="representedOrg"/>
          </source>
          <target>
            <context value="bundle"/>
            <contextType value="variable"/>
            <element value="entry"/>
            <variable value="custodianOrgEntry"/>
          </target>
          <target>
            <context value="custodianOrgEntry"/>
            <contextType value="variable"/>
            <element value="resource"/>
            <variable value="custodianOrganization"/>
            <transform value="create"/>
            <parameter>
              <valueString value="Organization"/>
            </parameter>
          </target>
          <target>
            <context value="custodianOrganization"/>
            <contextType value="variable"/>
            <element value="id"/>
            <transform value="uuid"/>
          </target>
          <target>
            <context value="custodianOrgEntry"/>
            <contextType value="variable"/>
            <element value="fullUrl"/>
            <transform value="evaluate"/>
            <parameter>
              <valueString value="'urn:uuid:' + %custodianOrganization.id"/>
            </parameter>
          </target>
          <rule>
            <name value="custodianOrganizationBase"/>
            <source>
              <context value="representedOrg"/>
            </source>
            <dependent>
              <name value="MapCDAOrganizationToOrganization"/>
              <variable value="representedOrg"/>
              <variable value="custodianOrganization"/>
            </dependent>
          </rule>
          <rule>
            <name value="custodianOrganizationFR"/>
            <source>
              <context value="representedOrg"/>
            </source>
            <dependent>
              <name value="MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization"/>
              <variable value="representedOrg"/>
              <variable value="custodianOrganization"/>
            </dependent>
          </rule>
          <rule>
            <name value="custodianRef"/>
            <source>
              <context value="representedOrg"/>
            </source>
            <target>
              <context value="composition"/>
              <contextType value="variable"/>
              <element value="custodian"/>
              <variable value="custodianRef"/>
              <transform value="create"/>
              <parameter>
                <valueString value="Reference"/>
              </parameter>
            </target>

  <group>
    <name value="MapCDAHealthCareFacilityToFrenchOrganization"/>
    <typeMode value="none"/>
    <documentation
                   value="CDA healthCareFacility -&gt; FHIR Organization facility française"/>
    <input>
      <name value="src"/>
      <mode value="source"/>
    </input>
    <input>
      <name value="tgt"/>
      <mode value="target"/>
    </input>
    <rule>
      <name value="serviceProviderOrganizationFR"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <element value="serviceProviderOrganization"/>
        <variable value="serviceProviderOrganization"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization"/>
        <variable value="serviceProviderOrganization"/>
        <variable value="tgt"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="Cas principal : healthCareFacility.serviceProviderOrganization existe.
On réutilise le groupe français général des Organization pour éviter de
reprofiler manuellement ici."/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="facilityIdentifiers"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <element value="id"/>
        <variable value="id"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapCDAIIToFrenchOrganizationIdentifiers"/>
        <variable value="id"/>
        <variable value="tgt"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="Cas complémentaire : si le healthCareFacility porte lui-même un identifiant,
on l’ajoute aussi à l’Organization de prise en charge."/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="facilityFR"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <condition value="src.serviceProviderOrganization.empty()"/>
      </source>
      <dependent>
        <name value="MapCDAOrganizationToFrenchOrganization"/>
        <variable value="src"/>
        <variable value="tgt"/>
      </dependent>
      <documentation
                     value="Cas de secours : si aucune serviceProviderOrganization n’existe, on applique
quand même les profils/identifiants français via le groupe général."/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="facilityOrganizationNameAbsentReason"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <condition
                   value="src.id.empty() and src.serviceProviderOrganization.empty()"/>
      </source>

        <context value="tgt"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>

        <parameter>
          <valueString value="string"/>
        </parameter>
      </target>

          </parameter>
        </target>
        <rule>
          <name value="url"/>
          <source>
            <context value="src"/>
          </source>
          <target>

            <transform value="copy"/>
            <parameter>

            </parameter>
          </target>
        </rule>
        <rule>
          <name value="valueCode"/>
          <source>
            <context value="src"/>
          </source>
          <target>
            <context value="absentReason"/>
            <contextType value="variable"/>
            <element value="value"/>
            <transform value="cast"/>
            <parameter>
              <valueString value="unknown"/>
            </parameter>
            <parameter>
              <valueString value="code"/>
            </parameter>
          </target>
        </rule>
      </rule>
      <documentation
                     value="CDA healthCareFacility sans id ni organization -&gt; FHIR Organization.name data-absent-reason"/>
    </rule>
    <rule>
      <name value="serviceProviderOrganizationNameAbsentReason"/>
      <source>
        <context value="src"/>
        <element value="serviceProviderOrganization"/>
        <variable value="serviceProviderOrganization"/>
        <condition
                   value="serviceProviderOrganization.name.empty() and serviceProviderOrganization.id.empty()"/>
      </source>
      <target>
        <context value="tgt"/>
        <contextType value="variable"/>

        <variable value="nameString"/>
        <transform value="create"/>

        </parameter>
      </target>

        <name value="dataAbsentReason"/>
        <source>
          <context value="serviceProviderOrganization"/>
